exposure: Congenital structural defects in the fetus
outcome: Prevalence of different types of congenital structural defects
cohort: 131 pregnant women seeking medical termination of pregnancy between 13 and 28 weeks gestation due to fetal congenital structural defects at a tertiary care teaching hospital between January and December 2022.
finding: The study identified central nervous system anomalies, particularly anencephaly, hydrocephalus, and acrania exencephaly sequence, as the most common congenital structural defects in fetuses of women seeking second-trimester medical termination of pregnancy.
